task_envelope.phase: Phase 1 - Choose the commercial wedge and target customer
task_envelope.objective: Validate whether owner-approved commercial inputs exist before business implementation.
known_facts: The repository contains an incomplete pilot decision template.
The pilot validator supports report-only and strict modes.
The owner supplied a direction for a consumer affiliate comparison with post-confirmation reward points.
The owner described all online users as the long-term audience and top-100 product discovery across platforms and Google as the product direction; bounded pilot scope remains open.
The owner described 40% of received affiliate commission for customer points, 40% for owner/business share, and 20% for platform scaling and maintenance.
The owner described 10 points as equivalent to ₹1 for voucher redemption, subject to formal approval and provider rules.
Amazon and Flipkart were identified as direct API candidates; Meesho, Myntra, AJIO, Nykaa, Tata CLiQ, Snapdeal, and JioMart remain unverified candidates.
No production approval is implied by local validation.
unknowns: Formal approval record for the reward-points model wording
Approved reward, referral, reversal, fraud, gift, and payout policies
Net/gross settlement deductions, partner-specific confirmation windows, and reversal treatment
required_user_or_owner_inputs: Resolve settlement deductions, partner-specific confirmation windows, reversal treatment, and the remaining policy fields
stop_conditions: Any required decision is missing or not explicitly approved
More than one or zero pilot models are selected
An agent attempts to choose business values without owner approval
Partner-specific settlement, confirmation, reversal, or voucher rules remain unapproved

selected_pilot_models: Consumer affiliate comparison with post-confirmation reward points
verification.phpunit: passed without coverage driver; 15 tests and 61 assertions

scope_completed: Captured the owner-provided commercial direction in audit/phase1-owner-input-capture.json.
Recorded the owner’s broad online-user audience, top-100 product-discovery direction, partner candidates, and external-merchant model in the decision template.
Recorded the owner’s 40/40/20 split of received affiliate commission and 10-points-to-₹1 voucher direction as unapproved policy inputs.
Added the post-confirmation reward-points model to the draft decision template as the selected direction.
Added validator regression coverage for the model and sign-off parsing.
Added a structured remaining-decisions checklist for owner completion.
Added partner integration research and a proposed role/timeline matrix, both explicitly marked unapproved where evidence is missing.
scope_intentionally_not_completed: No bounded initial product category selected
No target customer scope beyond broad online shoppers selected
No partner approval or platform permission asserted
No net/gross settlement, reversal, fraud, payout, voucher, gift, or partner-specific confirmation policy finalized
No staging or production action performed
open_blockers: Owner must complete and approve the remaining pilot policy, partner, metrics, owner, and sign-off fields before Phase 1 implementation can begin.

The received-commission basis and 40/40/20 direction are recorded, but settlement deductions, partner-specific confirmation/reversal rules, voucher policy, and formal Finance/Payout approval remain open.
limitations: Local verification does not establish partner contracts, production credentials, payout behavior, legal approval, capacity, or business viability.
Coverage-enabled PHPUnit was not used for the pass claim because the local PHP runtime has no coverage driver; CI is configured with PCOV.
